name: VCH Alignment Benchmark Index (VABI)
description: This technical treatise establishes a formal human-AI alignment and collaborative research protocol derived from the multi-paper development of the Viscous Cosmic Hydrodynamics (VCH) Framework. Key Formulations & Principles:- Dual-Agent Workbench Architecture: Operational framework linking domain specialist intent with AI-driven independent verification, numerical script execution, and pre-print document compilation.- Mathematical Verification & Code Execution Protocol: Implementation of Split-Step Fourier spectral routines for GPE fluid simulations, incorporating super-Gaussian absorbing boundary layers A(r) to eliminate numerical grid artifacts.- The VCH Alignment Benchmark Index (VABI): A quantitative evaluation metric (VABI = 0.35 S_math + 0.25 S_code + 0.20 S_debug + 0.20 S_doc) scoring AI performance across derivation accuracy, code execution success, stack trace debugging efficiency, and pre-print formatting compliance.- Verifiable Truth vs. Passive Accord: Alignment is maintained by forcing independent, step-by-step mathematical calculations rather than mimicking human user bias.- Reproducible Artifact Generation: Shifting AI evaluations from text outputs to functional code, numerical visualizations, and structured PDFs ensures transparent, peer-reviewable collaboration. This paper completes the VCH treatise series by establishing an empirical, reproducible standard for AI research alignment and collaborative scientific discovery.
